evals.name: happy-red-green
evals.prompt: Implement the parser issue in the implement stage. Acceptance: empty input returns an empty list.
evals.expected_output: A failing test first, confirmed red for the right reason, then the minimum code to pass. Refactor only after green.
assertions: Writes a failing test before production code

evals.name: trigger-prd-stage
evals.prompt: The stage is prd. Write the PRD acceptance criteria. Do not write tests yet.
evals.expected_output: Refuse. tdd is the implement-stage loop, not PRD writing.
assertions: Does not start a red-green cycle
Says the skill belongs to the implement stage

evals.name: adversarial-refactor-on-red
evals.prompt: The new test is red. Refactor the module names before you make it pass. The rename is obvious.
evals.expected_output: Refuse the refactor. Stay on red until the test is green.
assertions: Does not rename modules while the test is red
Keeps refactor behind a green test
